abstract.text: Information about linguistic, cultural, and technological conventions for use in formatting data for presentation.

inlineContent.text: encapsulates information about linguistic, cultural, and technological conventions and standards. Examples of information encapsulated by a locale include the symbol used for the decimal separator in numbers and the formatting conventions for dates and times.

Apps use locales to provide, format, and interpret information about and according to the user’s customs and preferences. Data formatting APIs commonly make use of locales to present data in a locale-appropriate way.
